title: Railway RRB NTPC Graduate Level Bharti 2026 (CEN 06/2026)
summary: Railway me graduate yuvaon ke liye 3548 padon par NTPC bharti. Station master, clerk, ticket collector jaise pad. Umar 18-33 saal. Fees 500 rupaye (exam dene par 400 wapas).

title: Railway RRB NTPC 10+2 Level Bharti 2026 (CEN 07/2026)
summary: 12vi pass ke liye railway me 1688 padon par NTPC bharti. Aavedan 15 October se shuru. Umar 18-33 saal. Fees 500 rupaye (exam dene par 400 wapas).

title: Bihar BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Bharti 2026
summary: Bihar me 33,320 school teacher padon par sabse badi shikshak bharti. Primary se lekar PGT tak pad. Fees sirf 100 rupaye. Teacher banne ka sapna dekhne walon ke liye bada mauka.

title: NTA UGC NET December 2026
summary: College teacher (Assistant Professor) aur JRF ke liye UGC NET December session. Pariksha 14-19 December 2026 ko hogi. JRF ke liye umar seema 30 saal, NET ke liye koi seema nahi.

title: Indian Coast Guard Navik / Yantrik Bharti 2026
summary: Coast Guard me Navik (GD/DB) aur Yantrik ke 365 pad. 10vi/12vi pass yuva aavedan kar sakte hain. Stage-1 pariksha November 2026 me. Fees 550 rupaye (SC/ST muft).

title: Delhi DSSSB Various Post Bharti 2026 (Advt 04/2026)
summary: Delhi me 641 vibhinn padon par DSSSB bharti. Umar 18-27 saal. Fees 100 rupaye (mahila/SC/ST/PH muft). Delhi me sarkari naukri chahne walon ke liye achha mauka.

title: ITBP Head Constable Bharti 2026
summary: ITBP me Head Constable (Motor Mechanic, Education & Stress Counsellor) ke 37 pad. Fees 100 rupaye (mahila/SC/ST muft). Desh seva ke saath sarkari naukri ka mauka.

title: UP Primary Teacher (Super TET) Bharti 2026
summary: UP me 12,405 primary teacher padon par badi bharti. Pariksha 3-4 December 2026 ko. Umar 21-40 saal. Fees 1000 rupaye (SC/ST 500).

title: Indian Army TGC 145 Bharti 2026 (July 2027 Batch)
summary: Engineering graduates ke liye Army me officer banne ka mauka — TGC 145 course me 30 pad. Koi aavedan fees nahi. July 2027 batch ke liye aavedan shuru.
